subject.title: feat(ui): complete Control UI MCP App bridge

question: Should the Control UI categorically reject bang-prefixed text from MCP Apps and widgets before the normal chat-send path, alongside slash-prefixed commands?
rationale: This determines the durable authority boundary between sandbox-originated content and host command syntax; the narrow repair is clear, but maintainers must confirm the policy rather than rely on an implicit command-prefix assumption.

options.title: Reject bang commands at the shared boundary
options.body: Block trimmed text beginning with `!` as well as `/` before confirmation and dispatch, preserving plain conversational messaging only.

options.title: Allow bang commands intentionally
options.body: Document and test the command-authority policy explicitly, including why an MCP App or widget may propose command text for the host chat path.

recommendation.title: Reject bang commands at the shared boundary
recommendation.body: Block trimmed text beginning with `!` as well as `/` before confirmation and dispatch, preserving plain conversational messaging only.
